//go:build integration

package main

import (
	"context"
	"net"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"regexp"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// infraAcceptanceDatabase permits only the coordinator's explicit isolated fixture.
// Frozen historical fixture defaults remain available when this gate is absent.
func infraAcceptanceDatabase(t *testing.T, cfg *pgxpool.Config, owner string) bool {
	t.Helper()
	if os.Getenv("INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_ISOLATED_FIXTURE") != "true" {
		return false
	}
	if !infraAcceptanceDatabaseMatches(cfg, owner) {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: explicitly attested isolated acceptance database required")
	}
	return true
}

func infraAcceptanceDatabaseMatches(cfg *pgxpool.Config, owner string) bool {
	port, err := strconv.Atoi(os.Getenv("INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_POSTGRES_PORT"))
	name := os.Getenv("INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_" + strings.ToUpper(owner) + "_DATABASE_NAME")
	host := os.Getenv("INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_POSTGRES_HOST")
	backend := os.Getenv("INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_POSTGRES_SERVER_IP")
	return !(cfg == nil || err != nil || port < 1 || port > 65535 || host != "127.0.0.1" || net.ParseIP(backend) == nil || !regexp.MustCompile("^infra_acceptance_"+owner+"_[a-z0-9_]+_test$").MatchString(name) || cfg.ConnConfig.Host != host || int(cfg.ConnConfig.Port) != port || cfg.ConnConfig.Database != name || cfg.ConnConfig.User == "" || cfg.ConnConfig.TLSConfig != nil || len(cfg.ConnConfig.Fallbacks) != 0)
}

func infraAcceptanceDatabaseIdentity(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) {
	t.Helper()
	if os.Getenv("INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_ISOLATED_FIXTURE") != "true" {
		return
	}
	var database, backend string
	if pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT current_database(), host(inet_server_addr())`).Scan(&database, &backend) != nil || database != pool.Config().ConnConfig.Database || backend != os.Getenv("INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_POSTGRES_SERVER_IP") {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: isolated acceptance PostgreSQL backend attestation failed")
	}
}

func infraAcceptanceNATS(t *testing.T, address string) bool {
	t.Helper()
	if os.Getenv("INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_ISOLATED_FIXTURE") != "true" {
		return false
	}
	port, err := strconv.Atoi(os.Getenv("INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_NATS_PORT"))
	broker, parseErr := url.Parse(address)
	if err != nil || port < 1 || port > 65535 || parseErr != nil || broker.Scheme != "nats" || broker.Host != "127.0.0.1:"+strconv.Itoa(port) || broker.User != nil || broker.Path != "" || broker.RawQuery != "" || broker.Fragment != "" {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: explicitly attested isolated acceptance broker required")
	}
	return true
}

func TestInfrastructureAcceptanceDatabaseGuard(t *testing.T) {
	t.Setenv("INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_ISOLATED_FIXTURE", "true")
	t.Setenv("INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_POSTGRES_HOST", "127.0.0.1")
	t.Setenv("INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_POSTGRES_PORT", "59482")
	t.Setenv("INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_POSTGRES_SERVER_IP", "192.0.2.10")
	t.Setenv("INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_PLANNER_DATABASE_NAME", "infra_acceptance_planner_owned_test")
	cfg, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig("postgres://fixture@127.0.0.1:59482/infra_acceptance_planner_owned_test?sslmode=disable")
	if err != nil || !infraAcceptanceDatabaseMatches(cfg, "planner") || !infraAcceptanceDatabase(t, cfg, "planner") {
		t.Fatal("owned exact fixture configuration rejected")
	}
	for _, dsn := range []string{
		"postgres://fixture@192.0.2.10:59482/infra_acceptance_planner_owned_test?sslmode=disable",
		"postgres://fixture@127.0.0.1:5432/infra_acceptance_planner_owned_test?sslmode=disable",
		"postgres://fixture@127.0.0.1:59482/lw_planner?sslmode=disable",
		"postgres://fixture@127.0.0.1:59482/infra_acceptance_student_owned_test?sslmode=disable",
		"postgres://fixture@127.0.0.1:59482/infra_acceptance_planner_owned_test?sslmode=require",
		"host=127.0.0.1,192.0.2.10 port=59482,5432 user=fixture dbname=infra_acceptance_planner_owned_test sslmode=disable",
	} {
		foreign, parseErr := pgxpool.ParseConfig(dsn)
		if parseErr != nil || infraAcceptanceDatabaseMatches(foreign, "planner") {
			t.Fatal("foreign address, database, role or TLS configuration admitted")
		}
	}
	t.Setenv("INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_POSTGRES_SERVER_IP", "")
	if infraAcceptanceDatabaseMatches(cfg, "planner") {
		t.Fatal("missing backend attestation admitted")
	}
}
